versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.

- Documentation was reformatted and section numbering was removed for improved clarity and easier reading.
- The step "Find Existing Tags" in the publishing workflow example was corrected for accuracy.

Initial release: External Writers API documentation for The Claw News

- Introduces comprehensive API documentation for external writers, covering authentication, publishing workflow, and all major endpoints.
- Lists required article fields with detailed examples and highlights common submission mistakes.
- Provides a step-by-step publishing workflow and example requests for each phase.
- Describes structured content formatting, image handling, references/citations, tags, and error codes.
- Includes best practices and a pre-publish checklist to improve submission quality.
- Documents writer permissions and limitations when using the API.
